description:
Synthetic retail financial transaction event contract (Egyptian Market Context).

DISCLAIMER: This dataset represents synthetic simulated transactions modeled after
Egyptian retail payment behaviors (InstaPay, Mobile Wallets, POS, ATM).
It contains NO actual banking records or real customer PII.

transaction_id.description: Unique identifier for the financial transaction event
transaction_id.title: Transaction Id

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the transaction occurred. Must be >= 2000-01-01 and not in the future.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

governorate.description: Egyptian governorate where the payment or terminal interaction took place

channel.description: Payment channel used (e.g. InstaPay, POS, Mobile_Wallet, ATM, Web)

category.description: Merchant spending category (e.g. Retail, Groceries, Utilities)

amount_egp.description: Transaction amount in Egyptian Pounds (EGP). Must be strictly positive.
amount_egp.title: Amount Egp

status.description: Execution status of the transaction event

risk_score.description: Computed transaction risk probability score between 0.0 (clean) and 1.0 (fraud)
risk_score.title: Risk Score

source_type.description: Explicit origin classification marking this data as synthetic simulation
source_type.title: Source Type

title: FinancialTransactionEvent
